name: Atlantis (STS-71)
about: Atlantis (STS-71) (1995-030A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1995 Jun 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1995 Jun 29), held fixed
docked to S20635; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
